title: Power BI On-Prem Data Gateway Availability
dataSources: Power BI activity events (`o365:management:activity` with `Workload=PowerBI`), Power BI REST Admin API (`/admin/groups`, `/datasets/refreshes`, `/capacities/refreshables`), on-prem data gateway `Mashup`/`GatewayInfo` logs, Premium capacity metrics.
app: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services / Microsoft 365 (`Splunk_TA_microsoft-cloudservices`) for the Power BI activity log; Power BI REST Admin API and on-prem data gateway logs via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=powerbi:gateway:info
| stats latest(gatewayStatus) as status, latest(_time) as last_seen by gatewayName, gatewayClusterName
| eval mins_since=round((now()-last_seen)/60,0)
| where status!="Live" OR mins_since>10
| sort - mins_since
description: Monitors the on-premises data gateways that connect Power BI to internal data and flags gateways that are offline or have stopped reporting in.
value: If the on-prem gateway goes down, every refresh and DirectQuery report depending on internal data fails; monitoring gateway liveness prevents a silent, widespread outage.
implementation: Ingest gateway logs or poll gateway status via the REST API; schedule every 5 minutes; alert on offline or stale gateways. Deploy gateway clusters for resilience.
visualization: Table of gateway status, single-value count of offline gateways, alert.

references.title: Power BI — Track user activities (audit log)

grandmaExplanation: We check that the bridge connecting Power BI to your internal data is up, so reports that rely on it do not suddenly stop working.
